notes.title: SCP Strategy is available now!
notes.content:
SCP Strategy is now available on Steam!

We are so glad you are about to play the result of many months of development work, sleepless nights, and time spent in the Early Access. But this is not the end. Be aware that the game still will be getting updated with new content like new SCP objects, special events, and much more. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/b9e248c8ca88040aa44d3b3f7163f2ff7904a80f.png

SCP Strategy gives you an opportunity to manage your own SCP organization. You can catch SCPs, make research, improve your MTFs and your organization! 

Your mission is to make the world a safer place! You can focus on research on every single SCP or catch all of them and then start research. It is all your choice!

[previewyoutube=5CZbjZdEwxE;full][/previewyoutube]
Will your decisions rescue the world? We will see…

Good luck & have fun!
LUXO Interactive team

notes.title: LUXO INTERACTIVE STATEMENT
notes.content:
We stand with Ukraine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/fa5c8fb77737a774448922484f4b96402e4e116a.png

A few days ago our friends from Ukraine, our neighbors were attacked by Russia.

War is wreaking havoc and innocent people are dying. We have no words to describe this difficult situation.

Our thoughts and prayers are with Ukraine. Stay strong!

We decided that all game income generated in Russia in the last 2 months will be donated to help Ukrainian refugees fleeing the war.

Thus believing that if we stay together, Ukraine will survive and overcome.

sincerely, LUXO Interactive

notes.title: Surprise! Cyber Attack is out NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Cyber Attack has just been released!

Take control of an elite global team of hackers, intercepting communications between corporations, governments, and criminals all around the world. In this game, you can choose to protect humanity by exposing private messages between dangerous individuals or exploit corporations to increase your fortune. The choice is yours.

[previewyoutube=KcbGcGG_PQc;full][/previewyoutube]

But don't worry! This is not the end of development.

Two new scenarios will be added in the coming months:

Crypto-Billionaire
The Villain


They will add new challenges and storylines.
Both will be added as FREE updates!
